_comment: DigitalLocks role→zone expectations. Editable. Position is matched case-insensitively against the substring keys below; the first match wins, so order the keys from most-specific to least-specific. Each entry's `allowedZoneKeywords` is matched (case-insensitive) against the concatenated zone+lock name. If at least one keyword matches, the role/zone is considered NORMAL. If none match, the event is flagged role/zone mismatch. Roles listed in `broadAccessPositions` are exempt from this rule entirely (AP, TLs, Coaches, Store Managers, vendor/contractor roles).
_exBroadAccessComment: The stocking / o/n / overnight / maint entries at the END of roleZoneMap are written against the CLOSED zone vocabulary this report actually emits (12 values, all locked high-value cases). The split is: TIER 1 general merchandise = stockable overnight; TIER 2 + Pharmacy + New Devices = restricted, staffed counters where merchandise is handed to a customer. Their keywords are deliberately ANCHORED ('electronics-tier 1', not 'electronics') so the TIER 2 desk does not match. Re-check them if the Power BI zone naming changes. Do NOT add comment objects inside the roleZoneMap array — an entry without a `position` matches every position and would silently disable the whole rule.
_verifiedDecisions: PHARMACY IS EXCLUDED FROM THE STOCKING MAPS ON PURPOSE (confirmed with the analyst 2026-08-20). 38-PHARMACY-TIER 1 is the behind-the-counter dispensing area, not an OTC salesfloor case, so an overnight stocker opening it is real signal — it produced 10 flags across the May 2026 export, 4 of them Critical. If this list ever gets 'cleaned up', do not add 'pharmacy' to the stocking / o/n / overnight entries.

'Fashion Stocking TA' resolves to the `fashion` entry, NOT `stocking`, because first-substring-match wins and `fashion` is earlier in the array. Fashion therefore keeps jewelry access for its stockers. Confirmed intended 2026-08-20 — do not reorder the array to make `stocking` win.
_droppedFromBroadAccess: stocking / overnight / o/n / maintenance were removed from broadAccessPositions on 2026-08-20. They are not broad-access: every zone in this report is a locked high-value case, so 'exempt from the mismatch rule' meant a stocker or maintenance associate could open the jewelry case at any hour and never be flagged. They now have explicit roleZoneMap entries below. `service technician` and `install` are kept exempt because they are vendor/contractor roles dispatched to any fixture in the building.
_edgeHoursComment: Job codes that are normally ON SHIFT across the edge after-hours bands (23:00-24:00 and 05:00-07:00) — overnight/CAP1, evening/CAP3 closers, maintenance, early-start fresh areas (bakery/deli/produce/meat), receiving/freight truck unload, OGP order filling, fuel, and front-end openers. Matched case-insensitively as a SUBSTRING of the Position column, same as broadAccessPositions. BEING ON THIS LIST IS NOT ENOUGH: the discounted AFTERHOURS_EDGE_EXPECTED weight applies only when the role/zone check ALSO passes (roleZoneMap allows the zone, or the role is broad-access). A bakery associate at a bakery lock at 5am is discounted; the same associate at an electronics case at 5am pays full AFTERHOURS_EDGE plus ROLE_MISMATCH. A position with no roleZoneMap entry can never be confirmed in-area and so never earns the discount — if you add a job code here, give it a roleZoneMap entry too. This does NOT affect the deep band (00:00-05:00), which stays at full weight for every role.
